title: Monotonicity of Clique Containment
statement: Let $G$ and $H$ be graphs on the same finite vertex set, and suppose every edge of $G$ is also an edge of $H$. If $G$ contains a clique of size $k$, then $H$ contains a clique of size $k$.
hypotheses_covered: Every edge present in $G$ is present in $H$
